# bench-stats report

**Input:** `bench_press_suite_5fd6396.json`. **Environment:** Dart golden on golden/golden.

**Settings:** δ = 3%, 95% intervals, per-process mean, FDR q = 0.05. Speedup = baseline time / candidate time, so > 1 means the candidate is faster.

## Group variants vs group baseline (paired by process)

| Benchmark | Speedup | 95% CI | Verdict (δ = 3%) | Detectable after BH | P (base / cand) | bench_press | bench_press `--threshold 0.03` |
| :--- | ---: | :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| `fast:aot:group=G` vs `base:aot:group=G` | 1.117× | [1.096, 1.139] | 🚀 faster ≥ 3% | yes | 3 / 3 | 🚀 Faster | 🚀 Faster |

> **Summary:** 🚀 1 faster ≥ 3% · ⚠️ 0 slower ≥ 3% · ✅ 0 no meaningful change · ➖ 0 inconclusive.
> **Detectable** (interval excludes 1): 1 of 1; 1 after Benjamini–Hochberg at q = 0.05. If nothing had changed, about 0.1 of 1 would be flagged detectable by chance without FDR control.

### Warnings

- `fast:aot:group=G`: baseline: only 3 processes (5+ recommended).
- `fast:aot:group=G`: candidate: only 3 processes (5+ recommended).

## Variance diagnostics

σ₁: trial-to-trial noise inside a process. σ₂: process-to-process spread, allowing for autocorrelated trials (ρ). k: how many times too narrow a single-process interval would be. Intervals are 95% parametric-bootstrap intervals.

| Benchmark | P | n | σ₁ | σ₂ | k | ρ | σ₂ drift-robust | Launch drift | bench_press share |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | :---: | ---: |
| `single:aot` | 1 | 16 | — | — | — | — | — | — | — |
| `multi:aot` | 4 | 6 | 1.29% | 0.71% [0.00, 1.54] | 1.7 [1.0, 3.3] | 0.00* | 0.58% | — | 29.8% |
| `unstable:aot` | 3 | 5 | 0.86% | 0.00% [0.00, 0.63] | 1.0 [1.0, 2.2] | 0.00* | 0.00% | — | 0.0% |
| `base:aot:group=G` | 3 | 4 | 0.98% | 0.43% [0.00, 1.20] | 1.3 [1.0, 3.3] | 0.00* | 0.63% | — | 30.7% |
| `fast:aot:group=G` | 3 | 4 | 1.09% | 0.00% [0.00, 0.90] | 1.0 [1.0, 2.3] | 0.00* | 0.00% | — | 0.0% |

Rows with — had a single process (or one trial per process): no between-process estimate.

ρ marked * was not estimated (fewer than 8 trials per process) and is assumed 0, so σ₂ may include within-process drift.

Launch drift — : fewer than 5 processes, too few to test.

---

Intervals are process-level Fieller intervals on per-process values (paired by process for group variants); they estimate the ratio of arithmetic means. Verdicts use the proposal's gate: the whole interval must clear ±δ (symmetric on the log scale) to call a change, or lie inside it to call no meaningful change. The bench_press columns show what bench_press 5fd6396 prints for the same data. Generated by bench-stats 0.0.1.
